purpose: Standalone reusable flat ink cave art kit based on approved character-led concepts.

rock.purpose: Large flat irregular rock material; world-space sampled.

backdrop.purpose: Low-detail blue distant cave. Close excavation backwall rendered separately.

ore.purpose: Four small embedded mineral markings in quadrants, no stone backing.

artContract.method: Built-in image generation for large bitmap source art; deterministic shared contours, clipping and floor bands in the offline renderer.
artContract.reason: Large reusable material sources suit image generation. Geometric masks and excavation shapes require deterministic construction.
artContract.seams: Shared world-coordinate sampling and contours precede chunk export. Generated texture opposite edges are not assumed seamless; a derived periodic material uses an 80-unit wrap blend, while the distant backdrop uses reflected addressing.
artContract.precision: Reuse frozen WFC sockets and shared smoothing. No claim of exact current Unity collision.
artContract.terrainScale: 80x48 modules, 4x4 game cells per module, 16 export pixels per cell; 5120x3072 full maps.
artContract.mining: Offline visual sample only. Ordered local cuts reveal a separately masked mineral layer and stable close backwall. No rewards, authoritative movement or network simulation.
artContract.preservation: Old art kit, original hero, Game, dependencies and other chat sources remain untouched.
artContract.finalSources: Record actual dimensions, alpha extrema, hashes and generated provenance after generation.
